When no celestial snapshot exists, the selected application path clears light intensity, resets exposure, and hides moon and stars if their single entities/materials are present.

conditional_findings.canonical_owner: StrategicMinute and its conversion to a bounded sidereal phase consumed by the celestial star transform.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If consecutive supported strategic minutes must yield distinct sidereal input, converting the entire absolute minute count to binary32 before reduction can collapse them.
conditional_findings.trace: StrategicMinute admits a u64 and days_since_epoch_f32 casts it to f32 before dividing by1440. The pinned-channel local Rust reference says integer-to-float casts use nearest with ties to even; local core source says f32 has radix2 and24 significant binary digits. At minute2^24=16,777,216 the next f32 integer is16,777,218, so16,777,217 is an exact midpoint and casts to16,777,216. Both minutes therefore feed the same day value to equatorial_to_world at equal latitude and longitude; no star matrix calculation is required to prove identical arguments. Their minute-of-day values are1216 and1217, and the separate sun direction source consumes minute_of_day at15 degrees per hour. Under the calendar source both are in year1575, about32 years after its epoch.
conditional_findings.consumer_trace: CelestialLightingSnapshot derives both the sun directions and star transform from the environment absolute minute; apply_presented_celestial_lighting copies the star transform to an existing star material when the celestial or settings resource changes. A tactical scene environment carries a typed absolute minute, and the inspected dispatcher forwards its input to the scene document.
conditional_findings.safeguards: This is symbolic IEEE binary32 integer-rounding and bounded source inspection; no minute, sky, matrix, material, image, schedule or renderer was run. Both times are admitted by StrategicMinute, but supported world lifetime, actual consecutive scene environments, celestial visibility, artistic resolution and tolerance policy remain unproved. Same star-time inputs do not assert a measured error, a gameplay penalty or a required high-precision ephemeris. Local Rust toolchain files match the channel named in the95e manifest; installation authenticity is not independently verified.
